# User Roles
Roles: 4

USER_ROLE Administrator
  Module roles: Administration.Administrator, System.Administrator, Inspection.Administrator, Notification.Administrator
  Manage all roles: yes
  Check security: yes

USER_ROLE Inspector
  Module roles: Administration.User, System.User, Inspection.Inspector, Notification.Inspector
  Manage all roles: no
  Check security: yes

USER_ROLE Manager
  Module roles: Administration.User, System.User, Inspection.Manager, Notification.Manager
  Manage all roles: no
  Check security: yes

USER_ROLE Anonymous
  Module roles: System.User, Inspection.Anonymous
  Manage all roles: no
  Check security: yes
